description: Bounded weighted blended order-independent transparency. A generated layered-glass scene exercises intersecting triangles in one primitive, primitive/draw order permutations, nested front/back glass, alpha decals, cutouts and emissive blends. The focused lane proves OIT is permutation-invariant while the recorded sorted fallback is not, then checks nearest-visible picking, resize/cancel/device-loss/low-memory behavior and Car/Camera paired visual cases.

knownDefects.description: Weighted blended OIT is order-independent but resolves a weighted colour average and a coverage product, not an exact front-to-back layer stack. The validated overlap range is eight layers; beyond it the image remains stable but is not claimed exact.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: OIT composites coverage, reflection and transmission as separate material terms but provides no refraction. T27 owns transmitted-scene sampling, tint and rough refraction.
knownDefects.label: limitation
